readsComponentsNote: the theme reads the slot's type and shape tokens (--ds-weight-*, --ds-size-*, --ds-tracking-display, --ds-leading-display, --ds-btn-radius, --ds-card-radius), so the emitter reads them off an OpenDesign system's reference page (components.html) as for Tracy Business (#1309). modesNote: the theme has a light/dark switch (.k-theme-toggle, data-theme on html): the slot emits the system's own side under the side the system is and the other side derived from it (src/derive.mjs), and keeps the switch (Akemi 13/10/2026: hiding it is a bug; MODE-2, which failed on the released 1.4.12: the switch disappeared on every view). The theme opens on the system's side from 1.4.14 (lib/ds-slot.ts reads the sheet's mode line; a choice made under a system is stored under kinetic-theme@<id>, UNDO-1)
templateNote: nothing to repoint: the theme's --k-* variables read --ds-c-* themselves (primary as text → accent-text, as a fill → accent through --k-primary-fill, its ink → accent-on); an empty map still makes the emitter write the --ds-c-* pairs as literals; 15/10/2026: the call band's buttons (Cta.astro .cta-btn and its ghost), the plan buttons (Pricing.astro .cta, .inc-btn) and .k-btn-ghost round with --radius-ghost, a 9px literal of tokens.css, not the --ds-btn-radius the hero and header buttons read: under Moxie the header's Start free was a pill and the call band's Start free a 9px box (v10 /product/features and /pages/helixql: button-primary.borderTopLeftRadius 9px against 1000px / Stripe's 4px, desktop and phone). --radius-ghost now reads the system's button radius, the template's 9px where the system states none (still literal: the footer's subscribe button, 9px, and FaqSupport's .btn, 10px)
fontNote: headings read Tailwind's --font-heading (Space Grotesk); the body reads --font-sans, which the emitter already sets
baseNote: the Terminal direction in its default dark theme, what the home page paints (styles/tokens.css)
bandTextNote: the call-to-action card (Cta.astro, look `card`) paints elevated → surface with 12% of --k-primary (the readable accent) at the top; its eyebrow in that same accent was proven on the page only: re-measured 11/10/2026 with the per-element probe it read 4.43 under MotherDuck and 4.27 under Apple. It takes the readable accent moved the least toward black or white that reads 4.5:1 on all four of those grounds (src/emit.mjs bandTextRules); the hero lays a 12% tint of its accent over the page in a radial glow under its eyebrow, which the readable accent is made for the plain page: 4.47:1 under Pitch on a phone (final measure 14/10/2026); the eyebrow reads on the page and on the tinted page
